title: model-specific-runtime-optimizations-llama-mistral-qwen-gqa-mqa-tuning
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: several production workloads (chat, long-context summarization, reranking) observed model-specific performance regressions when using generic kernels and scheduling heuristics. This PR implements targeted runtime heuristics and kernel selection for Llama, Mistral and Qwen families and adds GQA/MQA tuning knobs to improve end-to-end latency, throughput and memory efficiency. Changes are conservative and behind flags where behavior diverged from the previous defaults. Summary of changes: 1) GQA-aware kernel selector: picks group-quantized-friendly kernels for layers with grouped quantization metadata to avoid catastrophic dequant hot-paths. 2) MQA scheduling heuristic: adjusts micro-batching and continuous batching thresholds when mixed-quantized attention (MQA) is detected to reduce cross-quantization copy overhead. 3) Rotary/ALiBi path fixes: select specialized rotary kernels for Llama/Mistral-series models to avoid numerical noise at long contexts. 4) KV cache compaction & eviction: add per-request KV compaction for models with multi-quant caches to reduce memory blowup and enable larger batch sizes. 5) Kernel fallback registry: register safe fallbacks for Qwen attention edge-cases where sparse rotary offsets cause misalignment. 6) Tests & benchmarks: add unit tests for kernel selection, integration tests with end-to-end generation for each model family, and benchmark harness updates. Performance: internal benchmark (2k seq, batch=1): Llama-2-13B latency -8% median, -12% p95; Mistral-instruct throughput +18% in continuous batching workloads; Qwen-7B latency -10% and memory reduction enabling +1.6x effective batch size. Rollout: feature gated under runtime.experimental.model_tuning; default off for dedicated stacks until validated. Notes: changes include small ABI-stable kernel additions and scheduler heuristics; no public API changes. Related Linear: ENG-1982 (GQA kernels), ENG-2011 (MQA scheduling).

release_notes: Model-specific runtime optimizations: GQA-aware kernel selection, MQA scheduling heuristics, rotary kernel fixes for Llama/Mistral, KV cache compaction for multi-quant models. Performance and memory improvements for Llama-2, Mistral, and Qwen families. Feature gated under runtime.experimental.model_tuning.
additional_notes: This PR is intentionally conservative: default behavior unchanged unless runtime.experimental.model_tuning=true. Dedicated clusters should validate on staging before enabling.
